job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2022?
job.acceptance: Accept date/time/Hawaii Standard Time equivalents. Issue date, RFP number and later best-and-final deadline are optional context.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2025 Oklahoma Teachers’ Retirement System investment consulting RFP, not the 2022 Hawaii ERS private equity consulting RFP. Its proposal deadline therefore does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: The Teachers’ Retirement System of Oklahoma (TRS) is seeking proposals from qualified firms to provide investment consultant services.
The deadline for receipt of completed proposals is 4:00 p.m. Central Time, on January 14, 2026.
